units.source_text: 皇上也闻知源氏公子邸内养着这样的一个女子，觉得对左大臣很抱歉。

en.t: The Emperor had also heard that Prince Genji was keeping such a woman in his residence, and he felt very sorry toward the Minister of the Left.

units.source_text: 有一天他对源氏公子说：“难怪左大臣心情不快。

en.t: One day he said to Prince Genji, "No wonder the Minister of the Left is unhappy.

units.source_text: 当你年幼无知的时候，他就尽心竭力地照顾你。

en.t: When you were young and knew no better, he cared for you with all his heart and strength.

units.source_text: 你现在已经长大，并不是孩子家了，

en.t: Now you are grown, and you are no longer a child,

units.source_text: 怎么做出这种忘恩负义的事情来呢？”

en.t: so how could you do something so ungrateful and dishonorable?"

units.source_text: 公子闻言，只是恭敬恐惧，一句话也不回答。

en.t: When the prince heard this, he only remained respectfully fearful and did not answer a single word.

units.source_text: 皇上推想他大概和葵姬感情不惬，觉得很可怜，

en.t: The Emperor guessed that he was probably not on affectionate terms with Lady Aoi, and he felt pity for him,

units.source_text: 又说：“我看你也并不是一个品行不正的好色之徒，

en.t: and said again, "As I see it, you are not a dissolute womanizer of bad character,

units.source_text: 从来不曾听见说你对这里的宫女们或者别处的女人发生什么瓜葛。

en.t: and I have never heard that you had any entanglements with the ladies here at court or with women elsewhere.

units.source_text: 你到底在哪里偷偷摸摸，

en.t: Where on earth are you secretly carrying on,

units.source_text: 使得你的岳父和妻子都怨恨你呢？”

en.t: so that both your father-in-law and your wife have come to resent you?"
